parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `RadioPlayerTests.pauseStopsPlayback` (line 160) and `RadioPlayerTests.pauseResetsStream` (line 181) — carry `is_test: true` in their context flags. Although the two test methods share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.7778), they are distinct test cases verifying different observable behaviours of the pause operation: one asserts that playback stops, the other that the stream is reset. Collapsing them would obscure test intent and reduce failure-message clarity. Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is test-marked warrants no-action under reason_class 'test-fixture'; here both records are test fixtures.
